about: The structure of scene narration: the setting kinds, the cause label prefixes and the word that joins several names. It holds no sentences; they come from the bank (data/english/parts/scene-words.json) through src/director/mined/scene-bank.ts. A setting or cause the bank has no sentence for is left out. The narrator opens a scene with one short paragraph: the day, the setting, who is there, what led here.
